name: ai-roundtable
description: 讓多個 AI CLI(Claude Code、Codex 等)互相討論、分工、交叉審查的桌面應用
author: yanmin841111-byte

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:node && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:static
scripts.smoke:dist: node -e "const s=require('./dist/src/shared');const r=require('./dist/src/model-rules');require('./dist/src/orchestrator');if(!s.hasMarker||!r.resolveModelId)throw new Error('dist CommonJS exports incomplete');console.log('dist smoke passed')"
scripts.start: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron .
scripts.e2e: npm run build && node --import tsx test/e2e/run.ts
scripts.harness:ui: npm run build && node --import tsx test/harness/scenarios/ui-states.ts && node --import tsx test/harness/scenarios/i18n-en.ts && node --import tsx test/harness/scenarios/waiting.ts && node --import tsx test/harness/scenarios/retry.ts && node --import tsx test/harness/scenarios/review-visibility.ts && node --import tsx test/harness/scenarios/plan-output.ts && node --import tsx test/harness/scenarios/model-capability.ts && node --import tsx test/harness/scenarios/diff-without-git.ts
scripts.harness:live: npm run build && node --import tsx test/harness/scenarios/file-tools-live.ts
scripts.harness:login: npm run build && node --import tsx test/harness/scenarios/login-state.ts
